job.style: a conversation between a teacher and two students

passage: Teacher: Today, let us discuss why we need different nutrients. Rohan, do you think fats are bad for us? Rohan: Yes, I think we should remove all fats from our diet to stay thin. Teacher: Actually, fats provide us with more energy than carbohydrates, though we should eat them in moderation. Meera, what about protein? Meera: I think only bodybuilders need protein to grow big muscles. Teacher: That is a common mistake! Proteins are essential for every person to repair body tissues and support growth, not just for building muscles. Meera: What about vitamins? I heard they give us energy to run. Teacher: Vitamins are protective nutrients that keep us healthy and prevent deficiency diseases, but they do not provide energy. Also, remember that deficiency diseases like scurvy occur due to a lack of nutrients in our diet, not by catching germs from others. Finally, always wash vegetables before cutting them. If you cut them first, you lose important vitamins that wash away in the water. Rohan: I see! So, a balanced diet is about eating the right proportions of nutrients, not just equal amounts of everything. Teacher: Exactly, Rohan. A balanced diet provides the right amount of each nutrient for your body's specific needs.

items.evidence: Actually, fats provide us with more energy than carbohydrates, though we should eat them in moderation.
items.q: Rohan wants to cut all fats to stay thin. What would the teacher advise?
options: Keep some fats, as they give much energy
Cut all fats, as they always harm us
Eat fats freely, as more energy is better
Cut all fats, as vitamins give energy instead
items.explain: Fats give more energy than carbohydrates, so we need them, but only in moderation.

wrong.why: ignores the advice to eat fats in moderation

items.evidence: Proteins are essential for every person to repair body tissues and support growth, not just for building muscles.
items.q: Meera's grandmother has a cut that must heal. Which nutrient helps her body most?
options: Protein, which mends damaged body parts
Vitamins, which give the body energy
Fats, which give more energy than carbohydrates
Vitamin A, taken in a very large amount
items.explain: Proteins repair body tissues for every person, not only for bodybuilders.

wrong.why: picks a nearby fact about energy, not repair
thinks huge doses of Vitamin A heal injuries

items.evidence: Vitamins are protective nutrients that keep us healthy and prevent deficiency diseases, but they do not provide energy.
items.q: Meera takes vitamin tablets before a race. What will they actually do for her?
options: Keep her healthy, but not give energy
Give her extra energy to run faster
Build big muscles for the race
Give more energy than fats would
items.explain: Vitamins protect us and prevent deficiency diseases, but they do not provide energy.

wrong.why: thinks vitamins give energy for running
links nutrients only to building muscles
mixes up which nutrient gives the most energy

items.evidence: Also, remember that deficiency diseases like scurvy occur due to a lack of nutrients in our diet, not by catching germs from others.
items.q: Ravi's classmate has scurvy. How can Ravi best avoid getting it?
options: Eat foods with the nutrients he needs
Stay away so he does not catch it
Wash vegetables only after cutting them
Cut all fats out of his meals
items.explain: Scurvy comes from a lack of nutrients in the diet, not from germs passed between people.

wrong.why: thinks deficiency diseases spread like germs
thinks washing after cutting is healthier
thinks removing fats makes the diet healthy

items.evidence: If you cut them first, you lose important vitamins that wash away in the water.
items.q: Priya chops spinach first and then washes it. What happens to the spinach?
options: Its vitamins drain away with the water
It becomes cleaner and so healthier
It soaks up extra vitamins from the water
It loses germs that cause scurvy
items.explain: Washing after cutting lets important vitamins wash away, so wash vegetables before cutting.

wrong.why: thinks washing after cutting is healthier
reverses the direction of vitamin loss
thinks scurvy is caused by germs
